docs.text: Bronze schema data dictionary Notebook 07 recreates the bronze schema tables from the local MEVA-style exports. It removes the earlier public tables first, then replaces all Bronze data on every run. Relationships erDiagram videos ||--o{ events : contains events ||--o{ event_objects : includes objects ||--o{ event_objects : participates_in objects ||--o{ geometries : has videos { text video_id PK text video_name UK text camera_id text scene timestamp capture_start_local timestamp capture_end_local text capture_time_zone float duration_seconds int frame_count float fps int frame_width int frame_height text source_video_path text storage_bucket text storage_path UK text video_url jsonb source_metadata timestamptz created_at timestamptz updated_at } events { text event_id PK text video_id FK text event_name text description int start_frame int end_frame float start_seconds float end_seconds text source_status } objects { text object_id PK text source_object_id int detection_count float first_seen_seconds float last_seen_seconds jsonb label_details } event_objects { text event_id PK_FK text object_id PK_FK } geometries { text geometry_id PK text object_id FK int source_geometry_id int frame_index float timestamp_seconds text label float confidence text spatial_position jsonb bounding_box_pixels } event_objects is the only relationship between events and objects: an event can involve multiple objects, and an object can participate in multiple events. A geometry belongs to an object. There is intentionally no direct foreign-key relationship between videos and objects . bronze.videos Column Type Nullable Description video_id TEXT PK no Stable SHA-256 ID derived from the video name. video_name TEXT unique no Source MEVA video name. camera_id TEXT yes Camera identifier embedded in the source name, such as G340 . scene TEXT yes Scene label embedded in the source name, such as bus or school . capture_start_local TIMESTAMP yes Capture interval start parsed from the source name. capture_end_local TIMESTAMP yes Capture interval end parsed from the source name. capture_time_zone TEXT yes Capture time-zone status; currently unknown . duration_seconds DOUBLE PRECISION yes Original video duration. frame_count INTEGER yes Number of source frames. fps DOUBLE PRECISION yes Original video frames per second. frame_width INTEGER yes Source-frame width in pixels. frame_height INTEGER yes Source-frame height in pixels. source_video_path TEXT yes Original local AVI path at export time. storage_bucket TEXT yes Cloudflare R2 bucket containing the MP4. storage_path TEXT unique yes Object key in the R2 bucket. video_url TEXT yes Public Cloudflare R2 URL for the MP4. source_metadata JSONB no Original metadata-export object for traceability. created_at TIMESTAMPTZ no Row insert time; defaults to NOW() . updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ no Row update time; defaults to NOW() . bronze.events Column Type Nullable Description event_id TEXT PK no Stable SHA-256 ID, unique across all videos/cameras. video_id TEXT FK → bronze.videos.video_id no Parent video. event_name TEXT yes Model-generated event label. description TEXT yes Model-generated event description. start_frame INTEGER yes Inclusive source-frame start for the selected window. end_frame INTEGER yes Inclusive source-frame end for the selected window. start_seconds DOUBLE PRECISION yes Window start timestamp in the original video. end_seconds DOUBLE PRECISION yes Window end timestamp in the original video. source_status TEXT no Annotation provenance, currently generated . bronze.objects Column Type Nullable Description object_id TEXT PK no Globally unique SHA-256 ID derived from the source video ID and local tracker ID. source_object_id TEXT no Local YOLO tracker ID from the source export. detection_count INTEGER no Number of retained frame detections. first_seen_seconds DOUBLE PRECISION yes First observation time in the video. last_seen_seconds DOUBLE PRECISION yes Last observation time in the video. label_details JSONB no Per-label descriptions, confidence summary, detection count, and spatial positions. source_object_id is the local YOLO tracker ID and is not globally unique. The relationship to a video is represented only when the object is connected to an event through bronze.event_objects , then to that event's bronze.events.video_id . bronze.event_objects Column Type Nullable Description event_id TEXT PK/FK → bronze.events.event_id no Referenced event. object_id TEXT PK/FK → bronze.objects.object_id no Referenced participating object. The combined primary key (event_id, object_id) prevents the same object from being linked to the same event more than once. bronze.geometries Column Type Nullable Description geometry_id TEXT PK no Globally unique SHA-256 geometry ID. object_id TEXT FK → bronze.objects.object_id no Parent tracked object. source_geometry_id INTEGER no Original per-video geometry record ID. frame_index INTEGER no Original-video frame index. timestamp_seconds DOUBLE PRECISION no Time in the original video. label TEXT yes YOLO detector label for this frame. confidence DOUBLE PRECISION yes YOLO detection confidence for this frame. spatial_position TEXT yes Coarse position, such as top-left . bounding_box_pixels JSONB no Bounding rectangle: x_min , y_min , x_max , and y_max in original-frame pixels. The (object_id, source_geometry_id) pair is unique. Geometry labels can vary for a single tracked object because they preserve the per-frame detector result.
